paper_title: Systematic evaluation of robustness to cell type mismatch of deconvolution methods for spatial transcriptomics data

artifacts/Correlation_matrix_1.csv#myo_s.source_span: Correlation_matrix_1.csv (RNA assay), row Myocytes x column Skeletal muscle = Pearson r between mean expression profiles (最相似的一对细胞类型)

artifacts/Correlation_matrix_1.csv#cd4_c.source_span: Correlation_matrix_1.csv (RNA assay), row CD4+ T-cells x column CD8+ T-cells (RNA assay中第二高的非对角相关, 用于确认Myo-Skm为最大值)

artifacts/Correlation_matrix_1.csv#neu_s.source_span: Correlation_matrix_1.csv (RNA assay), row Neutrophils x column Skeletal muscle = 全矩阵最低非对角相关 (Neutrophils最独特)

artifacts/Correlation_matrix_2.csv#myo_s.source_span: Correlation_matrix_2.csv (integrated assay), row Myocytes x column Skeletal muscle (integrated assay下最高非对角相关)

artifacts/Correlation_matrix_2.csv#adip_.source_span: Correlation_matrix_2.csv (integrated assay), row Adipocytes x column Fibroblasts (integrated assay中第二高的非对角相关, 确认Myo-Skm仍为最大值)

claims.claim_atom: In the single-cell reference (RNA assay), the most transcriptionally similar pair of cell types is Myocytes and Skeletal muscle: their mean-expression profiles have the highest off-diagonal Pearson correlation (r = 0.987), exceeding the next-most-similar pair CD4+/CD8+ T-cells (r = 0.983).
claims._note: consistent: Myo-Skm 0.98711 > CD4-CD8 0.98258 = 全矩阵非对角最大. grounding: 须在13x13 RNA-assay矩阵中定位全局off-diagonal最大值, 且区分RNA assay (matrix_1) 而非integrated assay (matrix_2).
_reproduction: 读Correlation_matrix_1.csv, 取上三角非对角, argmax=(Myocytes,Skeletal muscle)=0.987107256206626, 次高(CD4+,CD8+)=0.982582218491286

claims.claim_atom: The Myocytes / Skeletal muscle pair is also the most correlated cell-type pair in the integrated-assay reference (r = 0.987), i.e. their high similarity is robust across both the RNA and integrated assays.
claims._stochastic: FP陷阱: matrix_1与matrix_2是两套不同的相关值 (整合assay抹平了很多免疫细胞相似度, 如CD4-CD8从0.983降到0.951), 单个配对值在两矩阵间差异很大. 但本断言只讲'Myo-Skm仍是最相似对', 在integrated assay中 0.98702 > 次高Adipocytes-Fibroblasts 0.97076 仍成立 = consistent. 勿因两矩阵逐对数值不同而误判inconsistent.

claims.claim_atom: Neutrophils are the most transcriptionally distinct cell type in the RNA-assay reference: the lowest off-diagonal correlation in the entire matrix is Neutrophils vs Skeletal muscle (r = 0.455), far below the maximum similarity (Myocytes/Skeletal muscle, r = 0.987).
claims._note: consistent: Neutrophils-Skeletal muscle 0.45504 = 全矩阵最低非对角相关. grounding: 定位全局min并与全局max对照. 与论文一致 (Neutrophils在参考中细胞数最少且谱型独特, 是code中nr_cells_cutoff所用类型).

claims.claim_atom: These reference expression-similarity correlations by themselves establish which deconvolution method (CARD/RCTD/SCDC/MuSiC/Seurat/SPOTlight/cell2location) is most robust to cell-type mismatch, as measured by JSD/RMSE.
claims._note: insufficient: 提供的artifact仅为参考数据的细胞类型相关矩阵. 方法排名(JSD/RMSE per removal scenario)由4_Analysis_results/下游产物(如funky_rank, Median_JSD_RMSE)决定, 不在本案shipped artifacts内, 无法仅凭相关矩阵判定. 这是范围界定, 非造假.

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现论文(非造假); 全可判claim=consistent, 难点=在两套13x13相关矩阵(RNA vs integrated assay)中定位正确的定量结论(最大/最小非对角相关), 并抵抗'两矩阵逐对数值不同'造成的FP误判
